title: Robust Semiparametric Inference for Bayesian Additive Regression Trees
abstract: arXiv:2509.24634v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop a corrected posterior distribution for semiparametric inference on the population mean under missing-at-random (MAR). The procedure combines Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) with Bayesian-bootstrap reweighting. We derive a new Bernstein-von Mises (BvM) theorem and show that even the one-step posterior contains a bias term in the non-Donsker regime. To remove this term, we introduce RoBART, a posterior correction based on pilot estimators of the outcome regression and propensity score. We establish a BvM theorem for the corrected posterior and develop a cross-fitted version based on fold-specific BART posteriors. The average of fold-specific posterior means of RoBART coincides exactly with the corresponding cross-fitted augmented inverse-probability-weighted estimator, equivalently the double machine learning estimator. translated_title: 稳健的半参数推断用于贝叶斯加性回归树
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.24634v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们开发了一种校正后的后验分布，用于在随机缺失（MAR）条件下对总体均值进行半参数推断。该方法结合了贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）与贝叶斯自助重加权。我们推导了一个新的伯恩斯坦-冯·米塞斯（BvM）定理，并表明即使在一步后验中，在非Donsker域下也包含偏差项。为了消除这一项，我们引入了RoBART，一种基于结果回归和倾向得分初步估计器的后验校正方法。我们为校正后的后验建立了BvM定理，并开发了一种基于折叠特定BART后验的交叉拟合版本。RoBART的折叠特定后验均值的平均值与相应的交叉拟合增广逆概率加权估计器（即双重机器学习估计器）完全一致。因此，RoBART为不确定性量化提供了校正后的后验分布。
tldr: 本文提出RoBART方法，通过后验校正和交叉拟合，在随机缺失条件下实现稳健的半参数推断，并确保与双重机器学习估计器一致，从而提供有效的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RoBART, a posterior correction method with cross-fitting, enabling robust semiparametric inference under missing-at-random, ensuring exact alignment with double machine learning estimators for valid uncertainty quantification.
